desc: ECU of the goldfish through plastic; the water line runs diagonally. Pull back and roll 90 deg: Barney walking along the ceiling of a white striped corridor, water pooled in the knotted neck of the bag.
camera: Pull back 0.2 m to 3 m with a 90 deg roll
audio: A single harpsichord note. Water slosh, steady footsteps, room tone.

desc: BARNEY in striped Didone capitals on bone paper; the letters fall upwards one by one and leave the frame.
audio: Three notes of the motif on the ondes; each letter lifts with a glass pluck.

desc: One-point symmetrical Breton-striped corridor. Barney walks towards camera and shrinks with every step.
audio: The 7/8 harpsichord ostinato starts; footsteps on lacquered wood.

desc: Cut to the side: the corridor is a funnel (an Ames room). Barney, normal size, stands at the narrow end beside a small red door.
audio: A marimba answer; one footstep.

desc: He opens the red door. Beyond it a chequered plaza stands on edge: the horizon is vertical.
audio: Door latch and creak; the motif upside down.

desc: He steps through and stands sideways on the plaza. The camera rolls 90 deg to agree with him. The water in the bag stays level with the old world.
audio: An organ pedal swells under the roll; the ostinato returns.

desc: He walks at a striped wall and straight up it without breaking stride. Across the square a pleated figure strolls upside down along an arcade.
audio: Footsteps stay exactly steady; distant fountain.

desc: Under the arcade, upside down, Barney grins at his fish. The fish, right way up for us, is upside down for him.
audio: A giggle; the glass harmonica plays the motif's first two notes.

desc: A procession of tall flat pleated paper people in lemon, cobalt, fuchsia and tangerine walks a pale runway in lockstep. Barney falls into step.
audio: The runway groove: marimba, harpsichord, claps, paper swish on every step.

desc: The camera orbits and the Pleats vanish edge on into lines, one by one. One folds itself into a crane and flies off.
audio: Paper folds; the music drops out for the vanish and returns.

desc: An isometric Penrose staircase. Barney climbs four flights and arrives where he began. He looks at us, turns, walks down, and arrives where he began again.
audio: A Shepard scale on harpsichord and marimba; the motif in retrograde when he walks down.

desc: The camera slides off the magic angle: the stairs are floating pieces at different depths. Barney stands at a gap and jumps it.
beat: The trick revealed, and he doesn't care
audio: The Shepard scale stops; one tick; a whoosh for the jump.

desc: A pleated tube slide in a playground of cones and stripes. Barney sits at the bottom of the slide.
audio: Distant playground birds; a creak.

desc: He slides UP, fast and delighted, the bag held high. The slide keeps going into the sky and throws him out.
camera: Follow up the tube, then tilt to sky
audio: Reversed slide squeak and reversed whoosh; a big glissando up.

desc: A vertical canyon of towers with layered flying traffic. Barney drops in and lands on the face of a tower, standing on it like pavement.
audio: City hum, horns, a heavier synth bass under the ostinato.

desc: He walks down the windows. Cars pass above and below him. A billboard shows a giant blinking goldfish.
audio: Doppler cars; the billboard jingle quotes the motif.

desc: The fin of an orange taxi nicks the bag. A drop squirts out and falls along the facade towards true down. He pinches the hole. It still drips.
audio: Pop, spray, drip. The music cuts to one sustained ondes note.

desc: A vast grey pleated plain under a flat grey sky. Only the fish is orange. The drips leave dark spots behind him.
audio: Silence apart from steps, drips and a thin wind.

desc: He sits. The bag is half empty and the fish is cramped. A drop falls from the bag upwards into the sky. He watches it go.
camera: Close, then tilt up with the drop
beat: The low point, then a clue
audio: One glass note that rises in pitch as the drop rises.

desc: He follows the drops. As he walks, the horizon tips and rolls over; the grey sky above turns deep blue. The sky was the sea.
audio: Organ and glass harmonica swell; the motif in retrograde inversion.

desc: Barney stands on the sky, the sea hanging over him like a ceiling of pleated waves. He kneels at its surface and unties the bag.
camera: Low, looking up at the water ceiling
audio: Underwater hush, glass harmonica.

desc: The goldfish slips into the sea, turns and looks back. Thousands of goldfish bloom in the blue, an orange murmuration.
audio: The only full statement of the motif, as a mirror canon: ondes, glass, harpsichord and strings.

desc: The fish touches its nose to the surface where his hand is, and swims away. Barney holds the empty bag.
audio: The canon resolves; one bubble.

desc: One continuous move: rise with the fish through the sea, and Barney's whole world resolves into a glass bowl on the sea floor.
camera: Continuous pull back and rise, about 1000x scale change
audio: The music thins to glass; underwater room tone.

desc: The goldfish looks in through the glass. Tiny Barney walks up the curved inside of the bowl and taps. The fish taps back. Its eye fills the frame with Barney reflected upside down. Cut to black.
camera: Close on glass, push to ECU of the eye
audio: Tink. Tink. Silence.

desc: Credits on white paper and stripes. Barney walks along the lines of text and over the edges of the frame.
audio: The motif on solo harpsichord, then the fish's tink at the very end.
